items.stem: ChatGPT returns a specific revenue figure for a prospect but cannot point to a source. How should the figure be treated?

options.text: As unverified until a reliable source confirms it
options.rationale: Correct: an unsourced figure must be verified before it is recorded as fact.

options.text: Entered into the CRM because it is specific
options.rationale: Specificity is not evidence; the figure may be fabricated.

options.text: Used to set the deal value immediately
options.rationale: Acting on an unverified figure risks a wrong commercial decision.

options.text: Rounded and entered to look more cautious
options.rationale: Rounding an unverified number does not make it reliable.

items.explanation: Correct: an unsourced figure must be verified before it is recorded as fact.

items.stem: Which TWO practices keep CRM updates auditable? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Recording the source for each updated field
options.rationale: Correct: a source lets the next user judge the data's reliability.

options.text: Recording the date the field was updated
options.rationale: Correct: a timestamp shows how current the value is.

options.text: Overwriting old values with no history
options.rationale: Destroying history removes the audit trail.

options.text: Creating a new record rather than updating the existing one
options.rationale: Duplicate records degrade CRM data quality.

items.explanation: Correct: a source lets the next user judge the data's reliability.

items.stem: Which principle should govern what personal data the workflow writes to the CRM?

options.text: Store only what is necessary and permitted for the sales purpose
options.rationale: Correct: data minimisation and permission limit what may be stored.

options.text: Store everything found in case it is useful later
options.rationale: Collecting unnecessary personal data creates privacy risk.

options.text: Store data only if ChatGPT marks it public
options.rationale: The model's classification is not a lawful basis for storage.

options.text: Store contact data without any retention limit
options.rationale: Indefinite retention of personal data is a compliance risk.

items.explanation: Correct: data minimisation and permission limit what may be stored.
